camel_example: aliyun sas DescribeDomainList --region cn-hangzhou --SourceIp '192.122.XX.XX' --DomainType root --PageSize 10 --CurrentPage 1 --FuzzyDomain sas
description_en: Queries information about your domain name assets
description_zh: 查询您的域名资产的信息
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-domain-list --source-ip 192.122.XX.XX --fuzzy-domain sas --domain-type root --page-size 10 --current-page 1 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainList

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The search keyword for the domain name to query. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的域名的搜索信息，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: fuzzy_domain

parameters.help_en:
The type of the domain name to query. Valid values:

root: root domain name
sub: subdomain name
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的域名类型。取值：

root：根域名
sub：子域名
parameters.name: domain_type

parameters.help_en: The number of domain names to display on each page in a paged query. Default value: 10, which indicates that 10 domain names are displayed on each page
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的域名的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条域名
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return in a paged query. Default value: 1, which indicates that the first page is returned
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

DomainListResponseList.description_en: The list of domain name asset information

Domain.description_en: The domain name or website name

IpList.description_en: The IP address information associated with the domain name

PageInfo.description_en: The pagination information of the query result
PageInfo.description_zh: 查询结果页面显示的信息

Count.description_en: The number of domain names displayed on the current page in a paged query
Count.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页面显示的域名的数量

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of domain names displayed on each page in a paged query. Default value: 10, which indicates that 10 domain names are displayed on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的域名的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条域名

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of domain names returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的域名的总数量

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
